task.title: Sharing and Permissions
task.shortdesc: Control who can view or download an uploaded recording.

step.cmd: Open a recording in your library and click Share.
Choose a visibility level: Private, Unlisted (anyone with the link), or Public (listed on your profile).
Toggle Allow Download to let viewers save the file locally.
Invite specific collaborators by email to grant edit access.
step.info: Inviting collaborators with edit access is a Pro-tier feature.
